title: ServiceNow and Anthropic Disclose AI Deal
content:
# ServiceNow 和 Anthropic 披露 AI 合作
通过此次合作，Anthropic 进一步深入企业 AI 市场。
作者：[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans)，特约撰稿人
2026年1月30日
阅读时间：2分钟
![ServiceNow 标志在手机上的图片](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf88ddd6d7f917822/697cc6a6822c19dae9c8889f/ServiceNow.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
在与 OpenAI 达成协议一周后，ServiceNow 与 Anthropic 签订了协议，将生成式 AI 供应商的 Claude 模型嵌入其跨行业的流程中，包括医疗保健和生命科学。
根据1月28日公布的协议，[Claude](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics/news/366637160/Claude-for-Healthcare-launches) 也将成为 [IT 服务供应商的 AI 代理构建器](https://aibusiness.com/agentic-ai/servicenow-unveils-ai-experience-agentic-features) ServiceNow Build Agent 的默认模型，该工具使任何技能水平的开发人员都能创建和部署能够自主行动和推理的代理工作流。
该协议还包括向 ServiceNow 的29,000名员工推出 Claude，并且 ServiceNow 将为工程师和技术团队提供 Anthropic 的 AI 驱动编码助手 [Claude Code](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-out-with-claude-opus-4-5)。
“ServiceNow 与 Anthropic 正在通过 AI 原生工作流将智能转化为行动，服务于全球最大的企业，”ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott 在一份声明中表示。这一合作……将构建、部署和扩展关键任务应用程序的能力交到每个行业、每个层级的每个人手中。”
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 在声明中表示，企业经常错误地将 AI 视为独立工具，而不是将其嵌入日常工作中，这在公司寻求增加 AI 部署时变得越来越重要。
“获得更好结果的方法是让 AI 成为你完成工作的不可或缺的一部分——融入工人每天所做的各种事情中，”他说。
这项协议是在越来越多关注支持代理 AI 和自主运营的背景下达成的，紧随 ServiceNow 最近与 Anthropic 的竞争对手 OpenAI 的 [合作](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership)。
在那项协议中，ServiceNow 将把 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.2 模型嵌入其平台，以支持 IT、HR 和客户服务等职能的自主 AI 代理。
这笔交易还加入了 Anthropic 的一系列合作协议，该公司最近与 [全球保险公司安联](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/allianz-partners-with-anthropic-to-accelerate-adoption-of-responsible-ai/) 以及埃森哲、IBM、德勤和 Snowflake 达成了协议，扩大了其大型语言模型的覆盖范围。

# ServiceNow and Anthropic Disclose AI Deal
With the partnership, Anthropic moves deeper into the enterprise AI market.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
January 30, 2026
2 Min Read
![Pic of ServiceNow logo on mobile](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf88ddd6d7f917822/697cc6a6822c19dae9c8889f/ServiceNow.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
A week after it forged a deal with OpenAI, ServiceNow entered into an agreement with Anthropic to embed the generative AI vendor's Claude models in its workflows across industries, including healthcare and life sciences.
Under the deal, revealed on Jan. 28, [Claude](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics/news/366637160/Claude-for-Healthcare-launches) will also be he default model for the [IT service vendor's AI agent builder,](https://aibusiness.com/agentic-ai/servicenow-unveils-ai-experience-agentic-features) ServiceNow Build Agent, which enables developers of any skill level to create and deploy agentic workflows that can act and reason autonomously.
The deal also includes the rollout of Claude to ServiceNow’s workforce of 29,000 employees, and ServiceNow will provide Anthropic’s AI-powered coding assistant [Claude Code](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-out-with-claude-opus-4-5) to engineers and technical teams.
“ServiceNow with Anthropic is turning intelligence into action through AI-native workflows for the world’s largest enterprises,” ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott said in a release. This partnership … puts the power to build, deploy, and scale mission-critical applications into the hands of every person, in every industry, at every level.”
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said in the release that enterprises often make the mistake of treating AI as a standalone tool rather than embedding it into day-to-day work, something that will become increasingly important as companies look to ramp up AI deployments.
“The way to get much better results is to make AI an integral part of how you get work done -- woven into the whole range of things workers do every day,” he said.
The deal comes as part of a growing focus on supporting agentic AI and autonomous operations and follows ServiceNow’s recent [partnership with Anthropic rival OpenAI](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership).
In that deal, ServiceNow will embed OpenAI’s GPT-5.2 model into its platform to power autonomous AI agents for functions such as IT, HR, and customer service.
The venture also joins a spate of deals for Anthropic, which recently forged agreements with [global insurer Allianz](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/allianz-partners-with-anthropic-to-accelerate-adoption-of-responsible-ai/), as well as Accenture, IBM, Deloitte, and Snowflake, as it expands the reach of its large language models.
